sources.name: Mobile signal strength measurement data from spectrum assurance vehicles
sources.coverage: Observed 4G and 5G signal strengths for all operators along sampled UK roads
sources.update_cadence: 2025 4G LTE and 5G NR data published 6 March 2026; periodic updates
sources.access: Open data, route map, methodology and usage guidance
sources.role: Observed on-the-ground cross-check against operator coverage predictions
sources.limitations: Routes are opportunistic/sampled and not comprehensive; precise drive path is not directly comparable with 100m x 100m prediction averages

sources.name: Mobile connectivity you can count on
sources.coverage: 2026 Ofcom programme on mobile quality/reliability with consumer, rail and Greater Manchester studies
sources.update_cadence: Discussion paper June 2026; Greater Manchester report July 2026; consultation closes 29 July 2026
sources.role: Current regulator framework for moving beyond simple coverage predictions
sources.limitations: Research/programme evidence; not a property-specific coverage guarantee

sources.name: Beyond Coverage - Mobile Connectivity in Greater Manchester
sources.coverage: Measured connectivity performance at selected indoor/outdoor venues and locations in Manchester and Bury
sources.role: Observed urban/indoor quality evidence showing coverage alone can miss user experience
sources.limitations: Targeted Greater Manchester sample is not nationally or parcel-representative

sources.name: Connectivity on Trains Measurement Study
sources.coverage: Measured mobile performance across 24 key railway segments in England, Scotland and Wales
sources.access: Official article, full study and line-by-line annexes
sources.role: Observed mobility/reliability evidence under difficult transport conditions
sources.limitations: Rail-route results should not be assigned to nearby fixed premises

sources.name: Map Your Mobile
sources.coverage: Postcode mobile coverage plus postal-district performance by network
sources.update_cadence: Live consumer checker using network predictions and crowdsourced performance data
sources.role: Consumer-facing blend of predicted coverage and observed performance
sources.limitations: Coverage and performance have different spatial granularity; postal-district performance is not parcel-specific

sources.name: Map Your Mobile coverage checker threshold methodology
sources.coverage: Signal-strength thresholds and crowdsource/prediction methodology used by Map Your Mobile
sources.role: Quality-control authority for checker signal categories
sources.limitations: Thresholds convert predictions into consumer-facing categories; they do not remove local indoor/terrain uncertainty

sources.name: Mobile Matters 2025

sources.update_cadence: 2025 report published July 2025; series updated periodically
sources.access: Official report, chart data and interactive report
sources.limitations: Crowdsourced sample and historical collection window do not provide exact present-day property coverage

sources.name: Ofcom Open Data - mobile signal measurements
